item.title: South Korean stocks tumble as US-Israeli war war roils markets
item.description: South Korean stocks tumble as US-Israeli war war roils markets South Korean equities slid sharply on Monday, with the benchmark Kospi index falling more than five per cent as turmoil in the Middle East rattled investors worldwide. In afternoon trading, the Kospi dropped 5.2 per cent to 5,922.30, wiping out part of this year’s gains as traders reacted to escalating instability linked to the widening conflict. item.title: Israel says air force jets targeting Iranian radar and missile sites
item.description: Israel says air force jets targeting Iranian radar and missile sites Israel’s air force is continuing operations against Iran’s air defence systems, targeting radar installations, missile launchers and personnel operating them, Israeli military spokesperson Avichay Adraee said on Tuesday. In a post on X, Adraee said Israeli aircraft also struck sites linked to Iran’s ballistic missile launch platforms.

item.title: Five IRGC members killed in Bushehr strikes
item.description: Five IRGC members killed in Bushehr strikes Five members of Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps have been killed in US and Israeli strikes on Bushehr province, according to the ISNA news agency. ISNA reported that the attacks targeted the cities of Deyr and Jam, resulting in the deaths of five Revolutionary Guards personnel.

item.title: US embassy in Kuwait closes until further notice
item.description: US embassy in Kuwait closes until further notice The United States embassy in Kuwait has shut its doors until further notice, one day after Iranian attacks on the country sent smoke rising near the diplomatic compound. An AFP correspondent reported seeing plumes of smoke above the mission on Monday following the strikes, underscoring how rapidly regional tensions have intensified. item.title: US orders embassy staff to leave Iraq, bars airport use
item.description: US orders embassy staff to leave Iraq, bars airport use The US Embassy in Iraq on Tuesday ordered non-emergency staff to leave the country “due to security reasons,” updating its travel advisory as regional tensions escalate. The mission also said US personnel in Baghdad are prohibited from using the city’s international airport because of security risks. item.title: Hezbollah strikes Israeli bases after Lebanon raids
item.description: Hezbollah strikes Israeli bases after Lebanon raids Hezbollah said on Tuesday that it had launched attacks on three Israeli military bases, describing the strikes as retaliation for Israeli bombardment of its strongholds in Lebanon, including the southern suburbs of Beirut. item.title: US envoy to Israel says it is unable to evacuate Americans in the country
item.description: US envoy to Israel says it is unable to evacuate Americans in the country The United States ambassador to Israel has said Washington cannot evacuate American citizens as the security situation deteriorates. “The embassy is not in a position to evacuate Americans or provide them with direct assistance,” the ambassador said. He added that Americans living in Israel face “very limited options” to leave the country as regional tensions escalate.
